adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the diff. Looking at line 11-12 in admin-group.js.es6, the totalPages calculation uses `Math.floor(this.get('user_count') / this.get('limit')) + 1`, which creates an off-by-one error when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g., 50 users with limit 50 would show 2 pages instead of 1). The spec file changes don't include tests for this pagination logic. However, this is categorized as important_non_bug rather than bug because: 1) it's a missing test coverage issue as stated in the finding, and 2) the pagination logic issue, while real, is in new code that lacks test coverage - the finding correctly identifies this gap.
